metadata.description: Public portable agent plugins for Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and OpenAI Codex — posture, coding, planning, security, Atlassian, GitHub, diagrams, and optional service stacks. Pair with archentic/marketplace for the archentic framework plugin.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-global
plugins.description: Core posture and writing/policy craft: execute-first, MCP-first, host URLs, STE/writing skills. Pair with business-analyst for planning and code for coding work (incl. Conventional Commits).

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-code
plugins.description: Coding standards and workflow: language rules (incl. YAML/Kubernetes); React/Next.js/Flask/FastAPI; Conventional Commits; refactor/debug/verify skills; worktrees, merge conflicts; coding agents.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-business-analyst
plugins.description: Business analysis and planning: BA brief skill, planner for ambiguous multi-step work, and external researcher. Pair with global (posture) and code (implementation).

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-atlassian
plugins.description: Atlassian craft: Jira and Confluence create gates, issue and page shape, and status. No project or space ids hard-coded.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-github
plugins.description: GitHub craft: pull request checks and comments, Actions workflow YAML, and default-branch CI. No product pipelines hard-coded.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-drawio
plugins.description: Diagram craft: author and repair .drawio files with lanes, gaps, and readable labels.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-security
plugins.description: Security practices: secrets, authentication, authorization, injection, cryptography, transport, supply chain, and data exposure. No product or vendor hard-coded.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-agentmemory
plugins.description: Gated AgentMemory MCP craft: lean always-on recall/capture rules, on-demand tool routing, and ops skill for slots/actions/mesh.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-jenkins
plugins.description: Agnostic Jenkins craft: build status, console triage, pipeline hygiene, and CI-from-main reminders. No product-specific jobs.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-lucidchart
plugins.description: Author and repair clean Lucidchart diagrams via Lucid Standard Import JSON (lanes, edge corridors) plus .lucid packaging.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-google-workspace
plugins.description: Google Workspace craft: Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets via MCP. Prefer connected Google Workspace MCP; never invent accounts or share links.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-google-cloud
plugins.description: Agnostic Google Cloud craft: project inventory, Compute/GKE, Cloud Storage, and hard gates on delete/IAM/public ACL. Prefer Cloud MCP when ready; else gcloud.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-freshservice
plugins.description: Agnostic Freshservice ITSM craft: create-only ticket filing, description shape, and honest status. Prefer Freshservice MCP when ready.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-vault
plugins.description: HashiCorp Vault craft: secret read/write posture, mount hygiene, and hard refuse to leak credentials into chat or commits. Prefer Vault MCP.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-grafana
plugins.description: Grafana craft: dashboards, Explore/Loki/Prometheus queries, incidents, and alerting via MCP. Prefer Grafana MCP; never invent datasource UIDs.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-cloudflare
plugins.description: Cloudflare DNS craft: list/create/update/delete records with explicit destructive gates. Prefer Cloudflare MCP; never invent zone ids.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-compose
plugins.description: Agnostic Docker Compose craft: multi-file COMPOSE_FILE layout, project-directory anchors, overlays/profiles, ops, and hard gates on destructive downs/volume wipes.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-kubernetes
plugins.description: Agnostic Kubernetes craft: portable manifest authoring plus pods, events, logs, and node signals via MCP. Prefer Kubernetes MCP; no destructive cluster changes without an explicit ask.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-proxmox
plugins.description: Agnostic Proxmox VE craft: list nodes/VMs, status, and gated power/clone/migrate via MCP. Prefer Proxmox MCP; never invent VMID or touch sacred hosts.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-argocd
plugins.description: Agnostic Argo CD craft: list/get apps, sync status, and gated sync/action via MCP. Prefer Argo CD MCP; never invent app names.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-prometheus
plugins.description: Agnostic Prometheus craft: discover metrics/labels, PromQL instant/range queries, and targets health via MCP. Prefer Prometheus MCP; discover before guessing.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-graylog
plugins.description: Agnostic Graylog craft: search logs, streams, and fields via MCP. Prefer Graylog MCP; never invent stream ids; keep secrets out of chat.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-minio
plugins.description: Agnostic MinIO / S3 craft: buckets, objects, tags, and gated delete via MCP. Prefer MinIO MCP; never invent bucket names; refuse secret dumps.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-velero
plugins.description: Agnostic Velero craft: list backups/schedules/restores and gated create/delete via MCP. Prefer Velero MCP; restores are irreversible without explicit ask.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-fortigate
plugins.description: Agnostic FortiGate craft: inventory policies/addresses/routes and gated firewall changes via MCP. Prefer FortiGate MCP; never invent policy ids; destructive needs explicit verb.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-yarr
plugins.description: Agnostic *arr / Plex / qBittorrent / Seerr craft via the yarr MCP fleet: search, status, and gated mutations. Prefer yarr MCP; never invent instance ids.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-victoriametrics
plugins.description: Agnostic VictoriaMetrics craft: discover metrics/labels, MetricsQL/PromQL query and range, TSDB status, and alerts/rules via MCP. Prefer VictoriaMetrics MCP; discover before guessing.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-runpod
plugins.description: Agnostic RunPod craft: list pods/endpoints/templates/GPUs and gated create/start/stop/delete via MCP. Prefer RunPod MCP; never invent pod or endpoint ids; cost-aware defaults.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-uptime-kuma
plugins.description: Agnostic Uptime Kuma craft: monitors, status pages, and notification channels with gated delete/pause. Prefer MCP when connected; otherwise API/UI. Never invent monitor ids.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-nginx-proxy-manager
plugins.description: Agnostic Nginx Proxy Manager craft: proxy hosts, SSL certificates, and access lists with destructive gates. Prefer MCP when connected; otherwise API/UI. Never invent host ids.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-vaultwarden
plugins.description: Agnostic Vaultwarden craft: admin/ops posture and Bitwarden-compatible API hygiene with hard refuse to dump vault contents or credentials into chat.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-kopia
plugins.description: Agnostic Kopia craft: repository and snapshot inventory plus gated snapshot/restore/forget. Prefer MCP when connected; otherwise kopia CLI. Complements Velero for non-K8s backups.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-authentik
plugins.description: Agnostic Authentik IdP craft: applications, providers, flows, and groups with gated destructive changes. Prefer MCP when connected; otherwise API/UI. Never invent object ids.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-traefik
plugins.description: Agnostic Traefik craft: routers, services, middlewares, and IngressRoute shape with destructive gates. Prefer MCP when connected; otherwise API/manifests. Never invent router names.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-tailscale
plugins.description: Agnostic Tailscale craft: devices, ACLs, and network inventory with gated ACL/device changes. Prefer MCP when connected; otherwise API/CLI. Never invent device ids.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-home-assistant
plugins.description: Agnostic Home Assistant craft: entity/state inventory, service calls, and automation hygiene with gated destructive actions. Prefer MCP when connected; otherwise API/UI.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-immich
plugins.description: Agnostic Immich craft: library/album/asset inventory and gated delete/share changes. Prefer MCP when connected; otherwise API/UI. Never invent asset ids; refuse credential dumps.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-portainer
plugins.description: Agnostic Portainer craft: endpoint/stack/container inventory and gated stack/container mutations. Prefer MCP when connected; otherwise API/UI. Never invent endpoint ids.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-zot
plugins.description: Agnostic Zot OCI registry craft: repository/tag inventory and gated delete/GC. Prefer MCP when connected; otherwise zot API/UI. Sibling to harbor — install what you run.

plugins.name: nodadyoushutup-harbor
plugins.description: Agnostic Harbor registry craft: projects/repos/artifacts inventory and gated delete/retention/robot changes. Prefer MCP when connected; otherwise API/UI. Sibling to zot — install what you run.
